utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Laguna Beach' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Orange County Power Authority (OCPA), the only CCA operating in Orange County, directly re-verified this session via its own homepage's 'Celebrating our member communities' listing as serving exactly four member cities: Buena Park, Fullerton, Irvine, and Fountain Valley. Laguna Beach is not among them, so Southern California Edison (SCE) is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: Laguna Beach is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Laguna Beach Community Development Department, Building & Permits Division
permit_authority.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated WebFetch was intermittent, not a persistent block). The page is a general building-permit page, not solar-specific; no dedicated solar page was found.

permit_url.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Laguna Beach/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Standard plan and checklist of all requirements, published on the City's website, substantially conforming to the California Solar Permitting Guidebook

required_documents.notes: Per Laguna Beach Municipal Code Section 14.84.050(a),(d)-(e): the building department adopts a standard plan and checklist substantially conforming to the CA Solar Permitting Guidebook, made available on the city's website.

value: Request inspections by emailing lbinspectors@lagunabeachcity.net before 4:00pm to receive an inspection the following business day (no same-day inspections); provide project address, permit number(s), inspection type(s), request date, and requestor name/mobile number
Confirm the inspection date/time via the city's Daily Inspections page or by calling (949) 497-0715 on the morning of the inspection after 8:30am; no confirmation call is placed to the requestor

Only one inspection shall be required and performed by the building division for eligible small residential rooftop solar energy systems, scheduled within two business days of a request; a subsequent inspection is authorized if the first fails
inspection_steps.notes: Combines the City's general Building Division inspection contact process with the solar-specific expedited-inspection provisions of Laguna Beach Municipal Code Section 14.84.070(g)-(i).

value.notes: Laguna Beach Municipal Code Section 14.84.070(a): 'For an application for a small residential rooftop solar energy system that meets the requirements of the approved checklist and standard plan, the building department shall issue a building permit or other non-discretionary permit within three business days.'

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Solar Energy System expedited permitting (Laguna Beach Municipal Code Chapter 14.84)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City of Laguna Beach

permit_fees.notes: Laguna Beach Municipal Code Section 14.84.060 states the building permit fee 'shall not exceed ten percent of the original system cost, but in no case more than one thousand dollars' — this is a legal fee CAP, not a stated actual charged fee amount, so it is deliberately not recorded here per this project's evidentiary rule distinguishing fee ceilings from actual fees.

value.role: City of Laguna Beach Building and Permits
